title: Crucible release provenance, v1
description: One publish ATTEMPT for a release, at releases/{sha}/provenance/{run_id}-{run_attempt}.json. Split out of release.json by alpha-engine-config-I9786: these three fields move on every rebuild of the same commit, so keeping them in the immutable identity record made a re-run of an unchanged commit an unconditional ReleaseImmutabilityError. Never immutable-checked — a second attempt for an already-published sha is EXPECTED to differ here, and each attempt is written unconditionally as its own durable record rather than contending for one slot.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that cannot read the version refuses the document rather than guessing.

sha.description: The commit this attempt built. Must match the release.json this attempt accompanies.

run_id.description: The CI run that produced this attempt (GitHub's GITHUB_RUN_ID). Part of this document's own key.

run_attempt.description: Distinguishes a 're-run failed jobs' retry that reuses the same run_id. Part of this document's own key.

built_at.description: When this attempt ran. Gotcha (I9786): sourced from github.event.repository.updated_at in deploy.yml, which is repository metadata, not the build instant — carried unexamined because a wrong-but-named field beats an absent one, and it is never used for anything but display.

workflow_run_url.description: The specific workflow run this attempt is. Different on every attempt by construction.

test_summary.description: The foundation-test line this attempt printed. Free text; not parsed by anything downstream.
